item.title: Deploy CUDOS v5 Dashboards
item.description:
CUDOS v5 Amazon Quick Sight SPICE

Estimated duration: 20 mins

Deploy CUDOS v5 Dashboards

Overview

CUDOS v5 consumes the CUR/Athena layer and publishes interactive cost intelligence through Quick Sight. AWS documents a v5 design using SPICE-backed summary, resource, and hourly datasets.

Learning Objectives

  • Understand the deployment prerequisites.
  • Deploy the current CUDOS v5 release.
  • Inspect Quick Sight datasets.
  • Verify SPICE ingestion.

Why This Matters for FinOps

CUDOS reduces the engineering required to create broad cost visibility, but it still depends on correct cost semantics and fresh upstream data.

item.title: CUDOS Dashboard Navigation & KPIs
item.description:
CUDOS v5 FinOps Amazon Quick Sight

Estimated duration: 15 mins

CUDOS Dashboard Navigation & KPIs

Overview

The goal is not to visit every sheet. The goal is to answer a sequence of cost questions and understand how the dashboard supports drill-down.

Learning Objectives

  • Identify total/current spend context.
  • Identify top services and accounts.
  • Explore cost trend and one technical domain.
  • Perform one resource or usage drill-down.

Why This Matters for FinOps

A good FinOps dashboard changes the next question: from total spend to ownership, drivers, and action.
